description: Compute 19 urban morphometric indicators for the bubenec neighborhood and write results to /app/results.json.

synthetic_attributes.building_height_metres: Assign linearly interpolated heights from 10.0 to 30.0 across all 144 buildings in index order

shape.fractal_dimension_mean: Mean fractal dimension of building perimeters
shape.circular_compactness_mean: Mean ratio of building area to minimum bounding circle area
shape.elongation_mean: Mean ratio of shorter to longer side of each building's minimum bounding rectangle
shape.convexity_mean: Mean ratio of building area to convex hull area

distribution.scope: Spatial relationships among buildings and streets
distribution.orientation_mean: Mean orientation of building footprints (deviation from cardinal axes, mapped to 0-45 degree range)
distribution.shared_walls_sum: Total length of shared wall segments between adjacent buildings
distribution.building_adjacency_mean: Mean fraction of a building's 5-nearest centroid neighbors that share a physical boundary via contiguity
distribution.street_alignment_mean: Mean angular deviation between each building's orientation and its nearest street segment's orientation
distribution.mean_interbuilding_distance_mean: Mean per-building average centroid distance to neighbors, using 5-nearest-neighbor graph expanded to 3rd topological order (including lower orders)

diversity.neighborhood: Contiguity graph on tessellation cells, expanded to 3rd topological order including lower orders, with self-loops
diversity.shannon_mean: Mean Shannon entropy of cell area distributions per neighborhood
diversity.simpson_mean: Mean Simpson concentration of cell area distributions per neighborhood
diversity.gini_mean: Mean Gini coefficient of cell areas per neighborhood
diversity.theil_mean: Mean Theil index of cell areas per neighborhood

network.scope: Street center-lines converted to a primal planar graph
network.parameters: Global metrics over the entire network (no radius limit)
network.meshedness: Meshedness ratio (independent circuits relative to maximum possible planar circuits)
network.cyclomatic: Cyclomatic complexity: number of independent circuits (integer)
network.mean_node_degree: Mean node degree across all nodes

elements_intensity.stroke_count: Number of natural street continuity groups formed by angular best-fit grouping of segments at junctions (integer)
elements_intensity.block_count: Number of enclosed urban blocks derived from tessellation, street, and building layers (integer)
elements_intensity.courtyard_mean: Mean courtyard count per building using queen contiguity with self-loops on building footprints

output.format: JSON object with metric names as keys and numeric values. Integer-valued metrics (cyclomatic, stroke_count, block_count) as exact integers; all others as floats.
